card.name: End of arrhythmias in overdose text
card.fires_on: The final piece of 'arrhythmias' in the overdose-management sentence 'Cardiac arrest or arrhythmias will require advanced life-support measures'. Also fires on the heading word 'Pregnancy' at the start of a new section.

modes.label: Arrhythmias in overdose text
modes.description: The ending of 'arrhythmias' in the stock sentence about cardiac arrest or arrhythmias needing advanced life support.
modes.example: Cardiac arrest or arrhythm<<ias>> will require advanced life-support techniques.

modes.label: Pregnancy heading
modes.description: The word Pregnancy opening a new section right after a sentence ends.
modes.example: to avoid alcohol while taking mirtazapine.<< Pregnancy>> Patients should be advised to notify their physician

card.writes: It pushes toward phrases like 'in the case of' or 'on the basis of' (mostly Chinese), and away from starting a new clause with we, there or they.
card.plain: It lights up at the end of the word arrhythmias in the standard overdose-treatment sentence, and on a Pregnancy heading.
